correctness.rationale: For tie-retaining synchronous majority on Q_n, n<=4, the transition is an exact bitmask map. Independent exhaustive recalculation of all 65,536 Q4 states with functional-digraph indegree pruning found exactly 702 fixed states, 885 primitive two-cycle orbits, and no cycles longer than 2; entry shells by period (0:702/1770, 1:9336/8000, 2:25344/9600, 3:8864/0, 4:1920/0) sum to 65536. It directly verified F^6=F^4 on every state and max entrance time 4. Source Python explicitly enumerates all 384 spatial affine automorphisms and partitions recurrent masks into 14 fixed and 16 two-cycle classes; source C++ independently exhausts all 65536 states. The finite enumeration is exhaustive, not induction to n>=5.
